biography.value:
Catastrophic dragons are living disasters born from the raw elements. Blizzard dragons bury villages in snow and freeze rivers solid as they pass, and they care nothing for treasure, only destruction.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .2RTrSEmciR0bEMYp]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .0SSgQkpQ8z5lYfH5]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .yqKV7YqGpRQibCY4]]{claws}.

Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=xAbQIGMq7qt5eFCt]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=xAbQIGMq7qt5eFCt]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=xAbQIGMq7qt5eFCt]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=j8hrh5CtwDqta6ad]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a howling blizzard in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=ksREZmTGn5xXxLK4]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=ksREZmTGn5xXxLK4]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=ksREZmTGn5xXxLK4]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, &reference[difficult terrain] composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.
Snow swirls around the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}: the area within 10 feet of it is lightly obscured.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Snow falls in a 40-foot sphere; the area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain.
  • Hail strikes a 20-foot square: DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage.
  • Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion from the cold.
